reference_rule: concept present in film when lexicon matches in >= 2 distinct cues
ungated_rule: concept present when lexicon matches in >= 1 cue
gated_rule: concept passes the Wikidata resolvability gate AND matches in >= 2 cues
gate_definition: a concept passes if its ontology entry has a dedicated Wikidata entity; the eight entries marked with a dash in Table 7 are blocked
note: Supersedes the 190-pair / ten-concept computation stored in detector_comparison.json and detector_comparison_v2.json; those artefacts cover a concept subset and should not be compared against the 456-pair figures printed in the manuscript.
unit_note: Precision and recall are computed over pairs. The eight concepts that never fire contribute only true negatives, so precision and recall are unchanged whether they are included in the denominator or not.
